parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: The wheel is a small serrated metal component located at the top of the lighter, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to create friction against the flint, generating sparks to ignite the fuel.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates when rolled by the thumb to produce sparks.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic component located near the top of the lighter.
parts.Functional_description: It releases the butane gas when pressed, allowing ignition when combined with the spark.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical housing of the lighter, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the butane fuel and supports the ignition components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural body of the lighter.
